Subject: Coupa enrollment kickoff + MSA gating items

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was pleased with the latency numbers and the data isolation options. We're ready to start enrollment in Coupa but have a couple of gating items before we ask our procurement team to push to vendor portal activation:

1) We noticed a conditional liability carve-out in section 11 of your MSA. Our legal team needs clarity on whether that clause applies to third-party data processors (specifically our patient identity vendor). Can you confirm whether Redwood treats downstream processors the same as "subprocessors" in that section?

2) Order form: we need the following PO fields validated on your side during activation: purchaser tax ID, bill-to address, remit-to (SFTP path preferred), and a PO-level custom field for contract ID. If Coupa maps any of these to custom attributes we need the mapping doc.

3) Timeline: our procurement lead has a weekly vendor packet deadline on 3/5. Ideally we'd have a redline back and a portal activation checklist by end of next week.

I've copied our procurement inbox (procure@luminahealth.com). Attaching our vendor onboarding template for reference.

(Attachment: Lumina_Vendor_Onboarding_Template.pdf)

Regards,

Quick activation notes for Anna / Lumina:

- Coupa mapping: we can add a custom attribute for "Contract ID" at the PO header level. We'll surface the mapping matrix once the onboarding ticket is created. (Attachment: orderform-field-matrix.xlsx)
- SFTP remit: we support SFTP drop with per-customer path; we'll need the public key and desired path from Lumina. There is a one-time ops change; estimate 48–72 hours after keys are provided.
- PO acknowledgement behavior: by default our ingest confirms receipt via API; if Lumina requires an emailed PO-ack PDF we can enable a confirmation flow but it's considered a non-standard feature and adds to the activation lead time.

Next steps: I'll open a Coupa activation request and link you to the ticket by EOD. Please advise whether Lumina needs the emailed PO-ack PDF or API-only acknowledgement.
